success.title: Payment successful
success.desc: Your booking has been submitted and is awaiting coach confirmation. Once confirmed, the meeting link appears in My Bookings.
success.note: For invoices or refunds, start from My Bookings or contact support.

cancel.title: Payment not completed
cancel.desc: The payment was cancelled and the time slot has been released. You can book again at any time.
cancel.note: If you ran into an issue while paying, try a different payment method.
